selector.rationale: The presence of atypical spindle and pleomorphic cells, positive immunohistochemical staining for vimentin, α-smooth muscle actin, p63, p53, and CD68, and a high Ki-67 labeling index support the diagnosis of Malignant fibrous histiocytoma.

rejected.label: Osteosarcoma
rejected.why: Lack of strong evidence for osteoid production or specific osteosarcoma markers
